groups.condition: The parsed document contains child nodes, including nested descendants.
groups.capability: XMLDocument::Clear and XMLNode child deletion safely release the descendants.
groups.consequence: Descendants are not safely released during document destruction.
groups.equivalence_reason: All four describe the same parsed-tree cleanup operation and failure, despite differing assessments of the deletion paths.

groups.condition: The caller supplies a null node.
groups.capability: XMLDocument::DeleteNode handles null before its node assertion.
groups.consequence: The null call reaches the assertion.
groups.equivalence_reason: All four concern the direct null-argument operation and the same assertion consequence.

groups.operation: Parse ordinary XML text with XMLDocument
groups.condition: processEntities=false and the text contains a recognized entity such as &.
groups.capability: XMLText::ParseDeep retains the entity in the text value.
groups.consequence: The entity-preserving ordinary-text mode cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same constructor setting applied to ordinary text parsing.

groups.operation: Parse ordinary XML text with XMLDocument
groups.condition: COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE is selected and the text contains repeated whitespace.
groups.consequence: The collapsed text value cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same whitespace mode, text input, and result.

groups.operation: Parse an XML element with XMLDocument
groups.condition: PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE is selected and whitespace-only text precedes a closing tag.
groups.capability: The parser retains that whitespace as a text child.
groups.consequence: The whitespace text child cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same pedantic parsing condition and retained-node result.

groups.operation: Parse an XML attribute with XMLDocument
groups.condition: processEntities=false and the attribute value contains a recognized entity such as &.
groups.capability: XMLAttribute::ParseDeep retains the entity in the attribute value.
groups.consequence: The entity-preserving attribute mode cannot be exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: This attribute parsing path is distinct from ordinary text parsing.
